description: Provenance: RegA GO annotation evidence tiers and evidence matrix for cGMP-PDE hypothesis
code:
import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# --- GO annotation evidence for RegA (Q23917) from UniProt/dictyBase ---
go = pd.DataFrame([
 ["GO:0004115","3',5'-cyclic-AMP PDE activity","MF","IDA (direct assay)","dictyBase","EXPERIMENTAL"],
 ["GO:0004114","3',5'-cyclic-nucleotide PDE activity","MF","IDA (direct assay)","dictyBase","EXPERIMENTAL"],
 ["GO:0047555","3',5'-cyclic-GMP PDE activity","MF","IBA (phylogenetic)","GO_Central","INFERRED-ONLY"],
 ["GO:0000156","phosphorelay response regulator activity","MF","IMP","dictyBase","EXPERIMENTAL"],
 ["GO:0005829","cytosol","CC","TAS","dictyBase","REVIEW"],
])
go.columns=["GO_ID","Term","Aspect","Evidence","Source","Tier"]
print("=== RegA (Q23917) GO annotations: cAMP vs cGMP MF evidence ===")
print(go.to_string(index=False))
print("\nKey contrast: cAMP-PDE = IDA (experimental); cGMP-PDE (GO:0047555) = IBA only (no experimental support).")
print("UniProt name: 3',5'-cyclic-nucleotide phosphodiesterase regA | EC 3.1.4.53 (= cAMP-specific PDE)")
print("UniProt FUNCTION: 'Phosphodiesterase specific for cAMP'")
print("UniProt CATALYTIC ACTIVITY listed: only 3',5'-cyclic AMP + H2O = AMP (RHEA:25277). No cGMP reaction.")

# --- Evidence matrix ---
ev = pd.DataFrame([
 ["UniProt Q23917 (PDE2_DICDI)","review/database","refutes-core","RegA hydrolyzes cGMP","'specific for cAMP'; only cAMP catalytic reaction; EC 3.1.4.53","D. discoideum","High (curated)"],
 ["dictyBase IDA (GO:0004115)","direct assay","qualifies","RegA substrate","Direct assay supports cAMP-PDE; no cGMP IDA exists","D. discoideum","High"],
 ["12429832 Bosgraaf 2002","direct assay","competing","which enzymes hydrolyze cGMP","GbpA=cGMP-PDE (cAMP not a substrate); GbpB dual, prefers cAMP 9x","D. discoideum","High"],
 ["11930017 Rascon 2002","structural/evol","qualifies","RegA catalytic class/specificity","RegA cat. domain class I, homolog TbPDE2B cAMP-specific, cGMP not hydrolyzed","T. brucei/Dicty","Medium"],
 ["9551091/12198158 van Haastert","mutant/direct","competing","cGMP-PDE identity (stmF)","stmF/GbpA is the intracellular cGMP-PDE, not RegA","D. discoideum","High"],
 ["24086589 Singleton 2013","review","supports-core","RegA function","'RegA is a cAMP phosphodiesterase'","D. discoideum","Medium"],
 ["GO:0047555 IBA","computational","refutes-hypo-support","RegA cGMP-PDE annotation","Phylogenetic carry-over from broad class I PDE ancestry","GO_Central","Low"],
])
ev.columns=["Citation","EvidenceType","Direction","ClaimTested","KeyFinding","Context","Confidence"]
print("\n=== EVIDENCE MATRIX ===")
print(ev.to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,3.0)); ax.axis('off')
t=ax.table(cellText=go.values, colLabels=go.columns, loc='center', cellLoc='left')
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(8); t.scale(1,1.4)
ax.set_title("RegA (Q23917) MF GO evidence: cAMP-PDE experimental vs cGMP-PDE (GO:0047555) IBA-only",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("rega_go_evidence.png",dpi=140,bbox_inches='tight')
print("\nsaved rega_go_evidence.png")
